about_the_game:
Experience Visions of Evil, a 4v1 PvP horror game where you play as a "Purger," performing rituals, using ancient weapons, and battling malevolent creatures. Protect the light to defeat the evil, or join the hellish beings to destroy the intruders. With a customizable progression system and unique abilities for both sides, the game offers an intense and personalized multiplayer horror experience.

Experience a new kind of multiplayer horror and get to know the fear of darkness and evil. No matter what happens, stay calm, do not let the light go out and keep your pulse steady.

PURGER:

Fight Back

Being defenseless is a thing of the past! With ritual weapons and clever use of your skills, you have a chance to strike back. Defend yourself and fight the darkness – or become the prey.

Finish Rituals to Obtain a Weapon

Survive the horror and turn the tide! Find and complete rituals to obtain powerful weapons. Only then can you face the monster and seize your last chance to survive.

Repair Powerboxes to Restore Lights

Darkness is your enemy. When the lights go out, the monster grows stronger and shows no mercy. Repair the powerboxes, bring the light back, and prevent the horror from taking control.


Loot Items and Consumables

Every item can mean the difference between life and death. Scavenge the environment, collect valuable gear, and find powerful consumables to gain an advantage. Adapt your strategy and fight for survival!

Collect and Use Cards

Your fate lies in your hands! Gather powerful cards and build your deck with unique abilities and bonuses. Choose wisely which cards to bring into play – every round can change everything.

MONSTERS:

Hunt the Purgers

You are the ultimate threat. Use your instincts and supernatural powers to track down the survivors. Sense their fear, follow their traces, and ensure that no one escapes.

Set Traps to Jump Scare Survivors

Surprise is your deadliest weapon! Place sinister traps and evoke panic-filled screams. Keep the survivors guessing when the next terror will strike.

Unlock New and Powerful Abilities or Passives

With every victim, you grow stronger. Unlock new abilities and passive bonuses that sharpen your hunting instincts and transform you into an unstoppable force.

Destroy Obstacles

No barrier can stop you! Smash obstacles and break through any defense, leaving survivors with no chance to escape. Let the world know that resistance is futile.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content

short_description: Enter a cursed world in Visions of Evil, a 4v1 online horror game. Explore a forsaken mansion, survive with weapons and artifacts, or become the monster and hunt the intruders. Will you face your fears, or become them?
